claim_scope: labeled maintainer measurement on the released runtime; not a qualification-bound product claim

runtime_identity.capture_adaptation: container relaunched from the identical image/model/arguments with bridge networking and a published host port because the capture host's WSL mirrored-loopback path was unavailable; serve arguments otherwise identical to the shipped profile

method.vantage: server-side loopback on the runtime host (WSL2), Python urllib streaming client
method.definition: TTFT = time from request start to the first streamed generated token event (reasoning or output text delta) over SSE
method.warm: one stored seed turn establishes the session; the measured follow-up sends a short input with previous_response_id
method.cold: a fresh prompt of equivalent length built from a different random seed (no possible prefix reuse), store=false
method.corpus: synthetic random words from a fixed 20-word vocabulary; content-safe by construction
method.script: committed inline in this file's provenance section of docs/BENCHMARKS.md history; single-sample, no warm-up discarded

caveats: synthetic corpus, not an agent transcript
cold time-to-first-token approximates full prefill of an equivalent-length fresh session and is consistent with the qualified prefill curve
numbers belong to this exact machine, image, and profile; they are not universal GPU claims
